title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: Images 5 and 12; step "bags"; kit.jsx Frame accessible description
findings.title: The bag table has no complete text alternative in the player
findings.problem: Frame replaces the full diagram description with the step caption. The "bags" caption explains osmolarity and D5W but omits the displayed classification lists. Because the SVG is exposed as role="img", its internal text cannot be relied on as separately accessible content. Screen-reader users therefore miss information sighted students receive, including the hypotonic saline examples.
findings.fix: Add a "desc" to the "bags" step containing all three displayed classification lists plus the D5W qualification. The existing Explainer logic already supports step-specific descriptions. Verify the rendered accessibility tree and screen-reader output, not just the visible caption.

assessment: Needs revision: screen-reader users lose the bag-classification table when entering the explainer.
